candidates.description: This vector represents common Thai quantifiers, determiners, and nominal prefixes.
This vector activates on common Thai conjunctions, connectors, and frequent sub-word tokens.
This vector represents Thai language characters, sub-word tokens, and words frequently ending with or containing the Thai consonant 'ส' (So Suea).
This vector represents Thai script fragments and character n-grams, particularly starting with the low tone mark "่า".
This vector activates on public health terminology and abbreviations associated with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
This feature vector activates on isolated Thai script characters, vowel markers, and linguistic fragments.
This feature vector activates on Thai script characters and Thai text fragments.
This feature vector represents numerical digits and numbers across different writing systems.
The feature vector represents laboratory and molecular biology techniques, specifically involving polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and related experimental procedures.
This feature vector represents common Thai noun-forming prefixes, morphemes, and linguistic roots related to abstract concepts, states, and qualities.
